title_sq: Mundesi Investimi! 3 Garsoniere ne Shitje tek Mine Peza ne Tirane
description_sq:
Mine Peza, perballe Golden Tower, Sdisponojme per shitje 3 Garsoniere+lavanteri te investuara ne detaje, te pershtatuara per AirBnb, me siperfaqe totale 84m2, kati 4 pallat 6 katesh, pa ashensor. Garsonieret jane te investuara nga e para duke filluar nga instalime elektrike, hidraulike (multistrat), dyer, dritare triple xham plastike, tavane te varura etj. Shiten te mobiluar si ne foto. Mundesi e mire investimi duke marre parasysh se aktualisht jane te dhena me qera 1400 Euro neto me kontrat noteriale per 3 vite.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Shitet 255 000 Euro
title_en: Investment Opportunity! 3 studios for sale in Mine Peza in Tirana
description_en: Mine Peza, in front of the Golden Tower, We have for sale 3 studios+laundry, invested in details, adapted for AirBnb, with a total area of ​​84m2, 4th floor of a 6-storey building, without elevator. The studios are invested from scratch, starting with electrical, plumbing (multilayer), doors, triple-glazed plastic windows, suspended ceilings, etc. Sold furnished as in the photo. Good investment opportunity considering that they are currently rented for 1400 Euro net with a notarial contract for 3 years. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For sale 255 000 Euro
